mentions.name: 12V Bluetooth ATV Keyless Start Relay
mentions.description: A small 12V Bluetooth relay module that replaces the physical ignition key on an ATV, letting the owner start the vehicle remotely via Bluetooth for keyless operation.
mentions.problem: The builder dislikes carrying physical keys and wanted to start the ATV without one.
mentions.source_excerpt: built a small 12V Bluetooth relay that lets me start my ATV without a physical key
